library.batch.label: Batch actions
library.batch.about: Select several songs and act on them at once.

library.priority.label: Priority songs
library.priority.about: Songs analysed first, whose stems are kept when the cache is cleared.

library.never_play.label: Never play
library.never_play.about: Songs Selecta won't pick when it builds a mix.

library.related_links.label: Connected songs
library.related_links.about: A song's details list the word connections found for it, each marked heard and kept or still a candidate.

library.corrections.label: Corrections
library.corrections.about: Fix a song's measured tempo, or say whether it's music.

library.capability_readiness.label: Readiness by capability
library.capability_readiness.about: Song details say separately whether a song can play, join mixes, have stems split and show timed lyrics.

library.card_view.label: Card view
library.card_view.about: The Library as cards instead of a list.

library.folders.label: Music folders
library.folders.about: The Sources tab: more than one folder, checking for new songs, and stopping watching one.

library.relink.label: Re-link a moved folder
library.relink.about: Point Selecta at a folder that moved, with a preview first.

library.folder_watching.label: Watching for new songs
library.folder_watching.about: Songs added to a music folder come in by themselves within about a minute.

lyrics.lookup.label: Lyric lookup
lyrics.lookup.about: Line-synced lyrics from LRCLIB. Only artist, title, album and duration are sent.

lyrics.display.label: Lyric display
lyrics.display.about: Shows lyric text in listening and discovery views where its use is permitted.

lyrics.word_timing.label: Word timing
lyrics.word_timing.about: When each sung word lands, for moves that hand over on a word.

analysis.time_estimates.label: Time estimates
analysis.time_estimates.about: How long analysing the rest of the library will take, and how accurate past estimates were, from this computer's own speeds.
